answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 161433 Country: Bangladesh Title: Today I kept fast but my tonsil pain started therefore needed to gargle. Can I gargle during fasting? Question: Today I kept fast but my tonsil pain started therefore needed to gargle. Can I gargle during fasting? Answer ID: 161433 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 31/775/SN=8/1439) You should bear a little pain but should not gargle in the state of fasting as in case water enters down the throat while gargling then your fast will be annulled. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
